talk. Nothing is less reliable
than assumptions!
pointers._flag: Manual layout/quality fix for route overflow QA batch

pointers.Original Text: 「それはそうかもしれないけど……」
「だろ！？　とにかくハルヒから仮定の話を持ち出されるのは嫌なんだ。すごくイライラする」
pointers.New Text:
Right?! Anyway, I hate it when
Haruhi brings up hypothetical
stuff. It really annoys me.
pointers.MT Text:
Right?! Anyway, I hate it when
Haruhi brings up hypothetical
stuff. It really annoys me.

pointers.Original Text: ちょっと無神経だったかな。
pointers.MT Text: Maybe I was a little insensitive.

pointers.Original Text: 自分は図太いところがあるから、繊細な話題が苦手な部分がある。
pointers.New Text:
I'm thick-skinned, so I'm not
good at delicate topics.
pointers.MT Text:
I'm thick-skinned, so I'm not
good at delicate topics.

pointers.Original Text: 光にとって触れられたくない繊細な部分に触れてしまったのかもしれない。
pointers.New Text:
Maybe I touched on a sensitive
spot that Hikaru didn't want to
be touched.
pointers.MT Text:
Maybe I touched on a sensitive
spot that Hikaru didn't want to
be touched.

pointers.Original Text: 「別に……僕も大人気なかったとは思うけど。あのさあ、ハルヒがさっき仮定の話したじゃんか」
pointers.New Text:
I don't think I was that popular
either... You know, about what
you said earlier.
pointers.MT Text:
I don't think I was that popular
either... You know, about what
you said earlier.
pointers._flag: Manual layout/quality fix for route overflow QA batch

pointers.Original Text: 「ならそれにならって僕も仮定の話を出しても構わないよね？」
pointers.New Text:
Then if that's the case, it's
fine for me to bring up some
hypotheticals too, right?
pointers.MT Text:
Then if you do that, it's fine for
me to bring up some hypothetical
stuff too, right?

pointers.Original Text: 「じゃあさ、もし僕がハルヒの持論にならって誰かと付き合ったとする。僕じゃなくて馨でもいいけどさ」
pointers.New Text:
What if I date someone, Haruhi
style? Could be Kaoru instead of
me.
pointers.MT Text:
What if I date someone, Haruhi
style? Could be Kaoru instead of
me.
pointers._flag: Manual layout/quality fix for route overflow QA batch

pointers.Original Text: 「そうしたらもうハルヒには構ってあげられなくなるよ？　彼女を構ってばっかりでハルヒが寂しくなっても遅いってわけ」
pointers.New Text:
Then you won't have time for
Haruhi, right? Too late once
she's lonely from being ignored.
pointers.MT Text:
Then you won't have time for
Haruhi, right? Too late once
she's lonely from being ignored.
pointers._flag: Manual layout/quality fix for route overflow QA batch

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルヒは……それでもいいって思う？」
pointers.New Text:
Haruhi... Do you still think
it's okay?
pointers.MT Text:
Haruhi... do you still think it's
okay?

pointers.Original Text: 「それは……仕方ないと思うよ。寂しくても光と馨が彼女と幸せならそれでいいと思うし」
pointers.New Text:
That's okay... I think. As long
as Hikaru and Kaoru are happy
with her, even if she's lonely.
pointers.MT Text:
That's okay... I think. As long
as Hikaru and Kaoru are happy
with her, even if she's lonely.

pointers.Original Text: 「！！？　そっか。ハルヒは僕らの幸せを考えて身を引くってこと」
pointers.New Text:
!!? So that's it. Haruhi's
stepping down to think about our
happiness.
pointers.MT Text:
!!? Oh, I see. So Haruhi's stepping
down to make sure we're happy.

pointers.Original Text: 「うーん、まあそんな感じかな」
pointers.MT Text: Hmm, well, I guess that's about it.

pointers.Original Text: 厳密に言うとちょっと違うんだけどね……。
pointers.MT Text:
Well, technically it's a little
different...

pointers.Original Text: 「……僕だったら踏み込んで荒らしまくるけどね」
pointers.New Text:
If it were me, I'd go in and
cause chaos.
pointers.MT Text:
...If it were me, I'd go in and
totally wreck the place.

pointers.Original Text: 「そんな質の悪いことできないよ……」
pointers.New Text: I can't do something so mean...

pointers.Original Text: 「うん。光も馨も自分たち以外に大切な人を見つけられたんだねって嬉しい気持ちになるかな」
pointers.New Text:
Hope they're glad Hikaru and
Kaoru moved on.
pointers.MT Text:
Hope they're glad Hikaru and
Kaoru moved on.

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルヒは僕らのお母さんじゃないだろ？　殿じゃあるまいし、家族ごっこなんてやめてよね」
pointers.New Text:
Haruhi's not our mom, is she?
You're no lord, so stop with the
family act.
pointers.MT Text:
Haruhi's not our mom, is she? She's
no lord, so let's stop playing
house, okay?

pointers.Original Text: 「環先輩と一緒にしないでよ。そうゆうんじゃなくて、友達として良かったねって祝福するってこと！」
pointers.New Text:
Don't compare me to Tama-chan! I
meant celebrate our friendship!
pointers.MT Text:
Don't compare me to Tama-chan! I
meant celebrate our friendship!

pointers.Original Text: ……明らかに不満そうだよね、その言い方。
pointers.MT Text:
...You sound pretty unhappy about
it, the way you said that.

pointers.Original Text: 騒がしい２人だけど、それがなかったらないで寂しさを感じる。
pointers.New Text:
They're noisy, but I'd feel
lonely without them.
pointers.MT Text:
They're noisy, but I'd feel
lonely without them.

pointers.Original Text: 「ちょっと？　ちょっとだけ嫌なわけ？」
pointers.New Text:
What's this? You don't like it a
little bit?
pointers.MT Text: Hey? You don't really mind, right?

pointers.Original Text: 「すっごく嫌！　とか言ったら心の狭い人みたいじゃない」
pointers.New Text:
I can't say I hate it! It'd
sound like I have a narrow mind.
pointers.MT Text:
I can't say I hate it! It'd
sound like I have a narrow mind.

pointers.Original Text: 「僕だったらちょっとでも嫌だったらそれはすごく嫌だけどね。自分にとって不快なものは即行排除だし」
pointers.New Text:
For me, even slight discomfort
is unbearable. I get rid of
anything unpleasant right away.
pointers.MT Text:
If I disliked it even a little,
I'd hate it. I get rid of
anything unpleasant fast.
pointers._flag: Manual layout/quality fix for route overflow QA batch

pointers.Original Text: 「……自分はもう少し常識人です」
pointers.MT Text: ...I'm a bit more of a sane person.

pointers.Original Text: 「嫌かな。なんだか凄く寂しいって気がする」
pointers.New Text:
I don't like it. I feel really
lonely.
pointers.MT Text:
I don't want to. I feel really
lonely.

pointers.Original Text: 自分で勧めておいて嫌、だなんて子供みたいな感情だけど……いつの間にか２人が傍にいるのが当たり前になってたのかもしれない。
pointers.New Text:
Hating something I suggested myself
is childish, but... maybe having
them both around just became normal.
pointers.MT Text:
It's childish after suggesting it,
but maybe having them nearby
became normal to me.
pointers._flag: Manual layout/quality fix for route overflow QA batch

pointers.Original Text: 「だよね。僕らがいなくなるとハルヒは寂しくて泣いちゃうもんね～」
pointers.New Text:
Right? Haruhi would be so lonely
and cry without us~
pointers.MT Text:
Yeah, Haruhi would be so lonely and
cry without us.
Nah, I don't think it's that bad...

pointers.Original Text: 「そっか、そっか～。仕方ないから当分はハルヒで遊ぶので勘弁してあげるよ」
pointers.New Text:
Got it, got it~. I'll go easy on
you for now and play with
Haruhi.
pointers.MT Text:
Got it, got it~. I'll go easy on
you for now and play with
Haruhi.

pointers.Original Text: なんだかもの凄く機嫌が良くなってしまった光にそこまでじゃないとは言い辛く。
pointers.New Text:
It's hard to tell Hikaru that
he's not really happy.
pointers.MT Text:
It's hard to tell Hikaru that
he's not really happy.

pointers.Original Text: （まあ、いっか。寂しくなると思ったのは本当のことだし……）
pointers.New Text:
(I guess it's fine. I really did
think I'd be lonely...)
pointers.MT Text:
(I guess it's fine. I really did
think I'd be lonely...)

pointers.Original Text: 「さてと、僕も接客にもどろっかな～」
pointers.New Text:
Well then, I guess it's time to
get back to serving customers~
pointers.MT Text:
Well then, I guess it's time for me
to get back to serving customers~

pointers.Original Text: いつものことながら気まぐれだなあ……。
「相談に乗ってくれたお礼に高級寿司でもおごろうかなって思ってたけど、別にいいよね」
pointers.New Text:
Thought I'd treat you to sushi,
but that's okay if you're busy.
pointers.MT Text:
Thought I'd treat you to sushi,
but that's okay if you're busy.

pointers.Original Text: 「なんか今、すっごく意地悪したい気分だからさ。今度ハルヒの前で大トロでも食べよっかな」
pointers.New Text:
Feeling mean today. Maybe I'll
eat sushi in front of Haruhi.
pointers.MT Text:
Feeling mean today. Maybe I'll
eat sushi in front of Haruhi.

pointers.Original Text: 「……じょーだん、冗談。今の顔見られただけで充分。じゃ、精々がんばれよー」
pointers.New Text:
...Just kidding. I'm satisfied
just seeing that face. Well
then, do your best!
pointers.MT Text:
...just kidding, just joking. I'm
satisfied with seeing your face
right now. Well then, do your best.

pointers.Original Text: ひらひらと手を振って暗闇に溶け込んでいく。
pointers.New Text:
Waving her hands, she blends
into the darkness.
pointers.MT Text:
She waved her hands and melted into
the darkness.

pointers.Original Text: 光の気まぐれは今に始まったことじゃないし、自分は引き続き接客を頑張ろうっと。
pointers.New Text:
Hikaru's mood swings aren't new,
so I'll just keep doing my best
with the hosting.
pointers.MT Text:
Hikaru's mood swings aren't new,
so I'll just keep doing my best
with the hosting.

pointers.Original Text: ……あの時、違った返事をしていれば、別の結末もあったのかな？
pointers.New Text:
...If I had answered differently
back then, would things have
turned out differently?
pointers.MT Text:
...If I had answered differently
back then, would things have
turned out differently?

pointers.Original Text: もし、あの時に戻れたら、今度は別の答え方を……
pointers.New Text:
If I could go back to that
moment, I'd answer differently
this time...
pointers.MT Text:
If I could go back to that
moment, I'd answer differently
this time...

pointers.Original Text: 「光がいつまで経っても戻ってこないから探してたんだよ」
pointers.New Text:
I was looking for you because
you never came back.
pointers.MT Text:
I was looking for you because the
light never came back.

pointers.Original Text: 「ごめんな、馨！！　……心配かけただろう？」
pointers.New Text:
I'm sorry, Kaoru!! ...I must
have worried you?

pointers.Original Text: 「ううん。無事に見つかって良かった……」
樹海で迷子になったんじゃないし、そこまで大げさに感動されても……。
pointers.New Text:
I didn't get lost in the
forest... and I don't need you
to get so worked up about it...
pointers.MT Text:
I didn't get lost in the
forest... and I don't need you
to get so worked up about it...

pointers.Original Text: 「あ、ごめん。邪魔しちゃったね」
「じゃあ僕は先に戻ってるからさ。光もちゃんと戻ってきてよね」
pointers.New Text:
I'll head back first. You better
come back too, Hikaru.
pointers.MT Text:
So I'll head back first. Make sure
to come back too, okay?

pointers.Original Text: 「……迎え、来たんだからちゃんと接客しなよ？」
pointers.New Text:
Since I came to pick you up,
give me proper service?
pointers.MT Text:
Since I came to pick you up,
give me proper service?

pointers.Original Text: 「そだね。……最後にさ、１つ聞いていい？」
pointers.New Text:
That's right. ...Can I ask you
one last thing?
pointers.MT Text:
That's right. ...Can I ask you
one last thing?

pointers.Original Text: 「ハルヒはさ、なんで僕たちを見分けられたわけ？　今まで僕たちを一発で見分けた人なんていなかったからさ」
pointers.New Text:
Why can you tell us apart? No
one has ever been able to do
that before.
pointers.MT Text:
Haruhi, how did you tell us apart?
No one's ever been able to pick us
out right away before.

pointers.Original Text: 「なんだ、そんなことか……簡単だよ、そんなの」
pointers.MT Text: Oh, is that all... That's easy.

pointers.Original Text: 「だって２人とも別の人間じゃない。どんなに似通っていてもやっぱり違うよ、２人とも」
pointers.New Text:
Because you're both separate
people. No matter how alike,
you're still different.
pointers.MT Text:
Cause you two ain't the same person.
Even if you look alike, you're still
different people.

pointers.Original Text: 「考えも行動も……似ているけどやっぱり違う。よく見ていればわかるよ、そんなに難しいことじゃないからね」
pointers.New Text:
Thoughts alike, actions differ.
Look closer, you'll see. Not
that hard to spot.
pointers.MT Text:
Thoughts alike, actions differ.
Look closer, you'll see. Not
that hard to spot.
pointers._flag: Manual layout/quality fix for route overflow QA batch

pointers.Original Text: 「……そっか。だよな、ハルヒの場合は相手をちゃんと見てから判断するもんな」
pointers.New Text:
...I see. That's right, Haruhi
always observes her opponent
before making a judgment.
pointers.MT Text:
......I see. Yeah, Haruhi always
takes a good look at someone before
she makes up her mind.

pointers.Original Text: 「なんかすっきりした。さんきゅーな」
pointers.MT Text: I feel all refreshed. Thanks a lot.

pointers.Original Text: 「ううん。自分もいろいろと話せて楽しかったし」
pointers.New Text: Nope. I had fun talking too.
pointers.MT Text: Nah, I had fun talking too.

pointers.Original Text: 「ま、今度なんらかの形で礼はするよ。馨と考えておくから楽しみにしとけよー」
pointers.New Text:
I'll return your favor next
time. Kaoru and I will think of
something. Look forward to it~!
pointers.MT Text:
I'll return your favor next
time. Kaoru and I will think of
something. Look forward to it~!
pointers._flag: Manual layout/quality fix for route overflow QA batch

pointers.Original Text: ひらひらと手を振って、暗闇に溶け込んでいく。
pointers.New Text:
Waving her hands, she blends
into the darkness.
pointers.MT Text:
She waved her hands flippantly and
melted into the darkness.

pointers.Original Text: 光と馨の２人が計画するんだからとんでもない騒動だとは思うけど……。
pointers.New Text:
I think it'll be a huge mess
since Hikaru and Kaoru are
planning it...
pointers.MT Text:
I think it'll be a huge mess
since Hikaru and Kaoru are
planning it...

pointers.New Text:
They're wild and crazy, yet
thrilling too...
pointers.MT Text:
They're wild and crazy, yet
thrilling too...

pointers.Original Text: 破天荒でめちゃくちゃな２人だけど、ジェットコースターのように刺激に溢れた２人でもあるから……。
pointers._flag: Manual layout/quality fix for route overflow QA batch

pointers.Original Text: 自分ですら気付かないうちに、笑みを浮かべていた。
pointers.New Text:
I was smiling without even
realizing it.
pointers.MT Text:
I was smiling without even realizing
it myself.
